written_by: development agent from the five catalog photos, before the first measured run; evaluator-only input (the author receives the request notes only)
identity_features: Oversized flat-top squared front: a straight, thick brow bar spanning the full width, squared upper lens corners, lower lens corners rounded, the lower rim curving inward toward the bridge
Thick acetate rims with a rounded, bevelled outer profile (not a flat extruded plate): the front face is convex/eased toward the edges and the frame reads as a chunky slab in the side view
Straight bridge flush with the brow bar, a keyhole-free bridge whose underside is an arch between the lenses
Wide endpieces continuing the brow line; the temples attach at the very top-outer corner, roughly as tall as the front at the hinge
Very deep temples (about 25-30 mm tall at the hinge) that taper along their length and bend down behind the ear; seen from the side the temple is a broad slab with a straight upper edge

Gold metal accent on each temple: a thin slanted gold bar/plate near the hinge on the outer face, plus small 'VICTORIA BECKHAM' lettering along the temple; a small 'VB' monogram mark printed on the lens
Material: dark navy acetate, polished (glossy highlights), with a translucent lighter-blue laminated inner side visible on the temple interior in the angled photo
Lenses: brown gradient, dark at the top fading to light amber at the bottom, mounted nearly flush in a rim groove; low base curve
Back view: the same navy acetate inside, visible gold hinge barrels at the inner endpiece corners
Proportions: total width about 2.2-2.3 times the front height; each lens about as tall as it is wide; a narrow bridge (about 14-15 mm at the nominal 140 mm width)
conditions_for_success: front silhouette and lens outlines match the front photo within the provisional thresholds of the job protocol
the rim reads as a bevelled acetate profile in the clay three-quarter render and in the AR angled view, not as a flat plate
temples have the deep tapering slab profile and the downward bend seen in the side photos, and are continuous back to the clip depth
gold accent present on the temples; lenses brown gradient with correct orientation (dark top)
